name: Owl. Calm Home
description: Owl.'s calm home page for any Chromium browser: a big clock, the line of your day, the pages you left, where your time goes, and OwlKick tracker blocking. Everything stays on this computer.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'
